name: kugiri
description: Splits text into lines, words and characters exactly where the browser already broke it.

paragraphs: Splits text into lines, words and characters exactly where the browser already broke it.

kugiri (区切り) is the point where one segment ends and the next begins. That is what this library finds: the line boxes the browser painted, the words and graphemes inside them, and nothing else. It cuts the DOM at those points and marks every unit so you can animate it, in CSS or in script. It never decides where a line should break; the browser did that already.

text-wrap: balance, authored newlines, , right-to-left text, scripts without spaces, hyphenation, overflow-wrap, text-indent, floats, multi-column layout, vertical writing and a target an ancestor scales all come out as painted. Words and characters are wrapped inside those lines under text-wrap: nowrap, so their boxes can never move a wrap.
